## Verification

<!-- Exact commands, tests, builds, dry-runs or manual checks performed. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and contains no unrelated generated/local files.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior and failure paths.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data or sensitive operational locations are included.
- [ ] Public outputs use canonical contracts and fail closed where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation/runbooks and changelog are updated when behavior or operations change.
- [ ] Architecture-impacting decisions include or update an ADR.
